'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Hundreds of residents flee and [[Nigerian Armed Forces|government forces]] withdraw after the town of [[Marte, Borno|Marte]] in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], is captured by [[Boko Haram|Islamic State – West Africa Province]] [[militant]]s. The military says it "tactically withdrew" troops, while confirming the town is under [[insurgent]] control. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security/residents-flee-islamist-insurgent-attack-on-town-in-northeast-nigeria-idUSKBN29M04T (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Automotive industry|Automotive]] manufacturers [[Fiat Chrysler Automobiles|Fiat Chrysler]] and [[Groupe PSA|PSA]] finalize their 50–50 [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] agreement, founding [[Stellantis]]. The new corporation becomes the world's [[List of manufacturers by motor vehicle production|fourth largest automobile manufacturer by volume]]. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/business-and-tech/a/1647662.html (AFP via RTL)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people die of [[carbon monoxide poisoning]] at a [[nursing home]] in [[Lanuvio]], [[Lazio]], [[Italy]]. Seven other people are hospitalized in critical condition. [https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2021/01/16/roma-cinque-morti-in-casa-di-riposo-a-lanuvio-altre-sette-persone-trovate-incoscienti/6067694/ (''Il Fatto Quotidiano'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[Canada]] surpasses 700,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7580374/coronavirus-update-canada-jan-16-700k/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] surpasses one million cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], becoming the first county in the [[United States]] to do so. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/los-angeles-becomes-first-county-hit-1-million-covid-19-n1254498 (NBC News)]
*****[[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] reports their first case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|UK variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a man who traveled to the [[United Kingdom]] and is currently in quarantine in [[Oregon]]. [https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/local/la-county-department-of-public-health-confirms-first-case-of-covid-19-variant-in-los-angeles/2507815/ (NBC Los Angeles)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports their first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a woman from [[Washtenaw County, Michigan|Washtenaw County]] who traveled to the United Kingdom. [https://nbc25news.com/news/coronavirus/new-covid-19-variant-identified-in-washtenaw-county-first-case-in-michigan (WEYI-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Louisiana]] reports their first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]  in the Greater [[New Orleans]] area. [https://gov.louisiana.gov/index.cfm/newsroom/detail/2925 (Office of the Governor of Louisiana)] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wyoming]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Wyoming]] reports their first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a man from [[Teton County, Wyoming|Teton County]] with no known travel history. [https://trib.com/news/state-and-regional/health/first-case-of-covid-19-uk-variant-found-in-wyoming/article_2ebd419f-68ab-56b1-9a85-7f9548d9e587.html (''Casper Star Tribune'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] launches the world's largest [[vaccination]] programme against [[COVID-19]] in [[India]], which plans to vaccinate more than 1.3 billion people. A sanitation worker is the first person to receive the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-55632782 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 14,224 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 896,642. [https://m.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20210116144728-20-594583/kembali-rekor-kasus-harian-corona-bertambah-14224-orang (CNN Indonesia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 4,029 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 155,095. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2021/01/657955/covid-19-daily-cases-breach-4k (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****The Drug Regulatory Authority of [[Pakistan]] approves the [[AstraZeneca]] [[vaccine]] for emergency use in the country. [https://www.livemint.com/news/world/astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccine-first-to-get-approval-for-emergency-use-in-pakistan-11610794728625.html (Livemint)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Denmark]] reports their first case of the South African variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a person who travelled to [[Dubai]]. [https://politiken.dk/forbrugogliv/sundhedogmotion/art8068150/Sydafrikansk-coronavariant-er-kommet-til-Danmark (''Politiken'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports records for both daily counts of new cases and deaths, with 10,947 new cases and 166 deaths, bringing the nationwide cumulative totals to 539,416 confirmed cases and 8,709 deaths. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/320_DGS_boletim_20210116.pdf (DGS)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSL8N2JR0B6 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]]
****[[Serbia]] receives one million doses of Sinopharm's [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. They are the first European country to receive a Chinese-made vaccine. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/serbia-gets-chinese-made-sinopharm-jabs-01610796003 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Vice President of Turkey|Vice President]] [[Fuat Oktay]] receives the first dose of the [[CoronaVac]] vaccine at a hospital in [[Ankara]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/turkish-vice-president-receives-covid-19-vaccine/2112424 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
*****[[Argentina]] receives their second batch of [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-01-16/argentina-receives-second-batch-of-russias-sputnik-vaccine (U.S. News & World Report)]
****Argentina also reports their first case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|UK variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a man who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] in late December and later tested positive. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-01-argentina-case-british-virus-variant.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil]]
*****The [[Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency]] announces that the [[Brazil|country]] has returned documents from União Química seeking approval for [[Russia]]'s [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine as it didn't meet the criteria. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-brazil-sputnik/brazil-health-regulator-sends-back-sputnik-v-vaccine-emergency-use-request-idUSL8N2JS003 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Qatar–Saudi Arabia relations]], [[Qatar diplomatic crisis]]
**Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister [[Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud]] announces that [[Saudi Arabia]] will re-open its [[embassy]] in [[Qatar]] in the coming days, after a diplomatic crisis that saw the nations severing ties for three years. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gulf-qatar-saudi/saudi-to-reopen-qatar-embassy-in-coming-days-saudi-minister-idUSKBN29L0DK?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**The [[Federal government of the United States|federal government]] carries out its final [[capital punishment|execution]] under the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]], executing convicted [[murder (United States law)|murderer]] [[Dustin Higgs]] by [[lethal injection]] at [[United States Penitentiary, Terre Haute|USP Terre Haute]] in [[Indiana]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-executions/u-s-carries-out-13th-and-final-execution-under-trump-administration-idUSKBN29L06J (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election]]
**[[North Rhine-Westphalia]] [[Minister president (Germany)|minister-president]] [[Armin Laschet]] is elected [[Leader of the Christian Democratic Union|leader]] of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]], one of the ruling parties in the [[Bundestag]] and the party of incumbent [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]]. Laschet's election makes him a front-runner to be the party's candidate in the [[2021 German federal election|federal election]] in September. [https://www.thelocal.de/20210116/merkel-ally-armin-laschet-elected-germanys-cdu-party-chief (AFP via ''The Local'')]
*[[2021 Ugandan general election]]
**The [[Electoral Commission of Uganda]] declares incumbent [[President of Uganda|President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] the winner of the presidential election, winning about 59% of the vote, while opposition leader [[Bobi Wine]] received only 35% of the vote, according to the commission. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-55689665 (BBC News)]
